# FreeUnit

> FreeUnit is the community LTS fork of the Unit application server: a polyglot
> app server (PHP, Python, Node.js, Ruby, Perl, Java, Go, WebAssembly) written in
> C as a multi-process runtime. Apache-2.0. This file tells people and coding
> agents where to build, test, review and report.

## Repositories

- [freeunit](https://github.com/freeunitorg/freeunit): the server (C). Source of
  truth, branch `master`. Agents treat it as **read-only**; merges and tags are
  human-only.
- [freeunit-harness](https://github.com/freeunitorg/freeunit-harness): contributor
  toolkit for people and agents — build, a running `unitd`, CI gates, A/B
  benchmarks, procedures. Start here.
- [freeunit-exp](https://github.com/freeunitorg/freeunit-exp): the Hermes bot's
  experimental fork — research, review, benchmark work on top of `freeunit` master.
  **Nothing here is a release.**
- [docs](https://github.com/freeunitorg/docs): documentation sources
  (reStructuredText, Sphinx).

## Install

- Build from source: `./configure --openssl --otel && make`
- Docker images: `freeunitorg/freeunit:<version>-<variant>` on Docker Hub
  (`php-8.4`, `node-24`, `minimal`, ...).
- Debian/Ubuntu `.deb` and `SHA256SUMS` are published as GitHub Release assets on
  each version tag.
- Check the current version and its supported PHP before deploying.

## Build and test

- Python suite: `sudo pytest-3 --print-log test/` — **stop any `unitd` on :8080
  first** (it breaks pytest at startup).
- C core / libunit: `./configure --tests --openssl && make && make build/lib/libunit.a && make tests && ./build/tests`
- Test-hook gate: `.github/scripts/check-test-hooks.sh` must exit 0.
- Build with `./configure --hardening=strict` before submitting.
- Style gate: ast-grep config under `tools/ast-grep/`, over `src/`.
- Easier path — the harness: `make doctor`, `make dev`, `make stop`, `make test`,
  `make ci-local` (`make help` lists every target). Start an agent in the harness
  root, **not** in `./src`.

## Contributing

- Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/freeunitorg/freeunit/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
  and the PR template.
- A change under `src/` needs a test under `test/` or `src/test/`; if none is
  warranted, add the `no-test-needed` label or a commit trailer with the reason.
- AI-assisted work carries a trailer: `Reviewed-by: FreeUnitOPS (<model>, <harness>)`
  — model and harness are for statistics and provenance.
- Keep the PR factual: state what was verified and what was not.

## Security

- Do **not** open public issues for vulnerabilities. Report privately to
  **team@freeunit.org** (or t.me/freeunit_support).
- Include: description, steps to reproduce, affected versions, impact. Severity
  uses CVSS v3.1.
- Coordinated disclosure: 48 h acknowledgement, 7 d assessment, fix within 30 d.
- Supported: 1.37.x (active), 1.34.x (LTS). 1.35.x / 1.36.x are EOL — upgrade.
- **Never** test an exploit against a live or production system you do not own or
  have written permission to test. Provide a PoC inside the report, not against
  someone's server.

## For coding agents

- Agent entry point: [freeunit-harness AGENTS.md](https://github.com/freeunitorg/freeunit-harness/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
  (also reachable as `CLAUDE.md`). Procedures live in `skills/` (names start
  `freeunit-`).
- Write and open PRs in **freeunit-exp**; treat **freeunit** as read-only. Merges,
  tags and releases are made by a human.
- Never print secrets (tokens, keys, credentials); replace them with `[REDACTED]`.
- Cite the code you reasoned about (file and line); say when a claim is unverified.
